Under the default UVM_APPEND, a callback runs "after previously added callbacks" (IEEE 1800.2-2020 §10.7.2.3.1). In uvm-core (src/base/uvm_callback.svh), the first instance add() copies the type-wide queue in order with push_back (lines 799/806). m_add_tw_cbs uses push_back for APPEND into the type-wide queue and into every instance queue (lines 283/303).
